key_phrases: multi-billion-dollar revenue run rate for Gen AI
analysis.reasoning: Amazon delivered a very strong Q1 with massive operating income growth (221% YoY) and AWS acceleration (from 13.2% to 17.2%). Management shows extreme confidence in the Gen AI era, viewing increased CapEx as a strategic necessity rather than a burden. While they noted some macroeconomic caution and FX headwinds, the focus on innovation (Amazon Q, Bedrock, custom silicon) and operational efficiency (regionalization) provides a highly positive outlook.
